# Rework claims — store_card_billing_and_disputes, round 3

Each round-2 item, its status, and where it changed. No figures are given here; they are in the task files and the worklog.

| item | status | location changed |
|---|---|---|
| R-C1r (gross postings compared with a net amount paid) | closed | card_ext_duplicate_final_credit: the confirmation test and the duplicate excess compare the postings with what the order record charged (its amount paid plus the refunds its order history books as returns, price adjustments and other refunds) — rule, compute order_refunds / order_charged / confirmed / dup_excess, cross_category reads; tasks/0.json adds a read of the order's history |
| R-D2r (dup still owed after its own settlement; wait on a withdrawn dispute) | closed | card_ext_duplicate_final_credit scope requires the most recent duplicate dispute to still stand open (no resolution entry referring back to it) — compute d_id / d_resolved / confirmed; card_ext_catch_up_payment prerequisite sentence and condition name the same open-dispute test |
| R-D3r (line wait met by a token or bounced payment; unsatisfiable when paid before the fee posted) | closed | card_ext_line_increase prerequisite sentence keyed on the plain record test "the minimum payment due on the missed statement is met in full by the payments recorded against it that were not returned unpaid" (compute cure_unmet, edge gate/condition/effect); card_ext_catch_up_payment states the same test, is nothing while it holds, and every shortfall tier pays at least the unmet part; tasks/0.json closure, tracing and contract texts |
| R-E1r (fee basis tiers coincide) | closed | card_ext_first_late_fee_courtesy: fee_basis_correction removed; the share is taken of the standing part (plain definition); new method factor loyalty_points (distinct inputs per tier) replaces the membership points; coverage_points restored as the sixth factor; tasks/1.json computations |

| N2 (net purchases defined inside one factor's sentence, duplicated in another) | closed | card_ext_line_increase: the usage factor's low-use tier now reads its own input (payments net of returns); net purchases belong to the purchase-volume factor alone |
| N3 (zero-amount courtesy leaves the refund wait unsatisfiable) | closed | card_ext_first_late_fee_courtesy qualification and card_ext_credit_balance_refund prerequisite sentence and condition both require at least 1.00 of the fee still standing (de minimis carve-out stated in both) |
| N4 (dispute-adjusted minimum double exclusion, single-dispute read, tie) | closed | card_ext_duplicate_final_credit late-fee tiers require the settled dispute to be the only billing-error dispute its first statement showed and its notice to come after that statement closed; the two-step adjusted-minimum sentence says why the printed minimum still included it; card_ext_catch_up_payment no longer adjusts for disputes (tier removed); tie rules stated for every most-recent read |
| N5 (one clearing period split into two summed factors) | closed | card_ext_credit_balance_refund: one family factor clearing_period owns the clearing window; new method factor dispute_interest_exposure (interest reinstated if the open dispute goes to the merchant) keeps the drawn count |
| N6 (second dispute-hold tier miscounts re-billed credits) | closed | card_ext_credit_balance_refund: second tier = provisional credits posted less those re-billed and less the amounts resolved for the cardholder (compute cardholder_resolved / dispute_hold, factor ladder) |
